title: Add JSONSchema strict response_format with improved error messages and OpenAI compatibility
author: Priya Sharma
description: Add a first-class JSONSchema-based response_format with a strict mode that validates model outputs before they are returned to clients, improve validation error messages for OpenAI-compat consumers, and provide backward-compatible fallbacks for streaming. Motivation: several customers reported surprising downstream failures when model outputs deviated from expected structured schemas; our current structured output helpers were permissive and had poor error messages making debugging hard (see ENG-1248). This PR implements a validation pipeline that runs after model decoding and before response emission; in strict mode the request will fail with a 422 and a structured error payload if validation fails, in permissive mode we attach a validation warning metadata and emit the best-effort output. Changes are implemented in the core response_format and validation layers and wired into the OpenAI compatibility handler so the error shape matches OpenAI-style error objects. The description below summarizes key changes, compatibility considerations, tests, and rollout plan.

merge_commit_message:
Add JSONSchema strict response_format + OpenAI-compatible errors

- Adds strict mode validation pipeline
- Maps validation failures to OpenAI-style error objects
- Adds permissive fallback for streaming and compatibility with existing clients
- Tests, docs, and changelog updates
release_notes: Added response_format="jsonschema" with optional strict=true. In strict mode invalid model outputs return 422 with an OpenAI-compatible error payload. Default behavior is permissive and attaches validation warnings. See docs/response_formats.md for migration steps and examples.
migration_notes: Clients that rely on permissive structured output should explicitly set strict=false or remove the strict parameter. Partners using OpenAI-compat must handle 422 with the new 'validation_error' type; examples are provided in docs/response_formats.md.
testing_summary: Unit tests added for validator edge cases, e2e test covering streaming+strict fallback, and integration test for nested schema cases. CI runs included microbenchmarks to verify no throughput regression; perf-bench shows <2% median latency increase under heavy batching, within SLO.
changelog_section: API: response_format: add jsonschema strict mode and improved OpenAI-compatible validation error messages
